prompt: Inspect this repository without changing it. Explain its package structure, runtime entry points, test commands, and the three highest-risk architectural boundaries. Ground the answer in specific files.

Design a concrete implementation plan for adding a new versioned workflow node end to end. Cover shared types and schemas, graph validation, engine dispatch, persistence/migrations, API, UI, packaging/rebinding, tests, rollout, and failure semantics. Do not claim to have changed files.

Review the system conceptually for places where process completion could be confused with verified business accomplishment. Give a prioritized audit checklist with evidence requirements and regression tests. Be explicit about unknowns.

Build and deliver a production-grade Agentic App named Talki Sales. It must operate a WhatsApp sales funnel with durable per-lead Subject state, explicit state-machine transitions, idempotent inbound event handling, bounded follow-up scheduling, specialist escalation, collections for leads/messages/events/metrics, an operator dashboard, structured audit evidence, and App Doctor verification. Create the real persisted App, workflows, surfaces, event rules, and test fixtures—do not substitute a design document. Use the task spine throughout, verify every acceptance criterion, repair failures, and only claim completion when the persisted App passes verification and delivery checks.
